snippet.title: Spooky Castle Trailer
snippet.description:
A 37-second trailer featuring game footage from one of Hamumu Software's oldest games, Spooky Castle.
Spooky Castle is the first game in the Adventures of Bouapha series, its sequel being Sleepless Hollow.
All game footage was recorded using Fraps and compiled with Windows Movie Maker.
Descent: FreeSpace trailer music was used in this video.

To get this game, visit https://hamumu.itch.io/spooky-castle
